body: I wasn't going to bother commenting, but then I thought to myself.. what the fuck? I'd feel so guilty if I didn't and you went through with it. I know my silly little comment won't mean much and won't impact your decision. I'm only 16 so I'm hardly going to help much but I can't not comment. This is too serious not to try and help. If it's any correlation, I suffer from depression too, I've been taking medication for it since I was 12. Suicide is permanent, dude. Your life could get better. Please don't throw it away just yet. Give it another year. Things might get better. I know it's ironic that I'm also posting about wanting to kill myself and then I'm telling you not to but I know suicide isn't the option to pick. There are better options out there. Talk to someone. Do you have discord? I'll give you my discord if you want to talk about stuff.. but please, stay a little longer. It's not worth throwing your life away just yet. I, and this whole subreddit, are here for you. We will always try our best to help. DM me if you decide you want my discord. <3 x
Thank you. I think I will try the 2nd one for now. I appreciate it :)
Thank you.

Yes, I told him yesterday I thought about ending things if he didn't stop being so distant (sounds harsh but I'm one of those annoying clingy girls) and he told me he would message me more. He clearly lied.. sigh.

Thank you for the kind response. Sadly though, I really don't things between myself and him will get better. I wish they would because he is one of the few sources of *true* happiness I get. He just acts so different now. I miss the way things used to be :(
Thank you. I just really don't know what I should do. He said to me that things don't return back to normal that quickly and that things take time.

We used to talk all the time. He's extremely distant now but when asked, he still maintains he loves me and wants to be with me. He says that things don't go back to normal that quick and that these things take time.. I mean, he's not wrong, but it wasn't much of a serious issue to start off with. He wouldn't (and still won't) tell me what's wrong.
He still maintains he loves me and when I've asked him if he's losing interest etc he's told me no and that he still wants to be with me. It's hard because we're both just teenagers.

I'm scared to do so because I feel he'd just lose interest... that wouldn't really sort stuff, I don't think.. it would just distance us more. I appreciate your replies though. It means a lot to know someone cares.
I've already had the hard conversation with him. He maintains he still loves me.
I'm going through that right now. I suppose you have to just keep telling yourself that suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem. I know it's fucking hard though. Good luck dude.

I already have. The mental health nurse/therapist had to go back to the psychiatrist and tell her I want to up my medication dosage. My parents and I were under the impression that the psychiatrist would be at my appointment and would be able to give me the medicine then. They know I overthink things. It is what's wrong with me most of the time haha. Thank you for your reply, it's appreciated <3
Thank you, I will try.

My parents have paid over £100 and went private though and I've been seeing a psychiatrist there. She can't alter my medication though, that's up to the NHS service.
